what: When moving to another document on the same site, a browser View Transition is used — the old screen shrinks to .9× in place and fades to .25, while the new screen opens over it with a clip-path from bottom to top. Both run 1.75s cubic-bezier(.86,0,.07,1). Ordinary links that load a new document work as they are, so page scripts need not be split

options.dur: Transition length (s), default 1.75 — shorten it if pages change often, like in an app
options.shrink: Scale the old screen shrinks to, default .9
options.fade: End opacity as the old screen fades, default .25
options.ease: Curve (”.86,0,.07,1” or a css curve name), default cubic-bezier(.86,0,.07,1)
options.shift: Distance the old screen travels down while shrinking (measured after shrinking, px if no unit), default 0 — brand 5vw
options.origin: Axis on which the old screen shrinks, default center · ‹top› means top-edge center — brand top
options.clip: The share of the new screen covered from the top at the start (inset top), default 100% (fully covered). brand 85vh (starts with only the bottom 15% visible)
options.rise: Distance the new screen is initially pushed down, default 0 — Brand page 15vh

use: <html data-fx="page-vt-reveal"> — On both pages involved in the transition. Load fx.css in the head (@view-transition can only be enabled from css)
note: Cross-document View Transition (same origin) in Chrome 126+ and Safari 18.2+. Where View Transition does not work, such as a page opened from a file, only the body of the page reached by a link opens from below with the same curve (no old-screen shrink). The original is a single-page app (next-view-transitions), so it runs the same keyframes within one document.

from.where: shared.css transition — original ::view-transition-old/new(root) page-exit · page-enter 1.75s cubic-bezier(.86,0,.07,1)

All pages <html> — original Nuxt pageTransition page: the leaving sheet goes opacity .5 · scale(.9) translateY(5vw) · origin top, the entering sheet goes clip-path inset(85dvh 0 0) + translateY(15dvh) → 0, both 1.1s cubic-bezier(.75,0,.1,1) at the same time = dur: 1.1 · ease: .75,0,.1,1 · fade: .5 · shift: 5vw · origin: top · clip: 85vh · rise: 15vh
